mission.goal: Provide a public-safe immutable Federation estate delta contract and deterministic source-only routing for federation census and provider observation.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane and governed Federation operators
mission.workflow: validate a bounded external census-genesis source bundle, structurally validate later append-only event types and their hash chain, and select one exact A0 observation route without runtime activation
mission.data: public-safe JSON contracts, redacted aliases, canonical SHA-256 hashes and externally stored immutable census transactions
mission.interface: Python library functions and versioned JSON contracts
mission.stack: Python 3.11+ standard library and JSON Schema 2020-12 contract
mission.environment: Federation-Omega source checkout; generated transactions remain in an approved external immutable evidence plane
mission.governance: Formation Engine, EvidenceOps proof-before-claim, Superior Logic v3.2 and ECASP, MODISA Code-Forge 3.3, zero-cost and no-trust-transfer controls
mission.failure: fail closed on tamper, chain gap, private material, totality promotion, route ambiguity, authority expansion, cost, burden or runtime activation claim
mission.testing: healthy and failure-first unit tests, adjacent Federation regressions, compilation, JSON parsing, diff checks and public leak guard
mission.deployment: source-only draft PR; no merge, workflow, runtime deployment, provider call or evidence-plane mutation in this mission
mission.continuity: canonical event hashes, sequence fencing, correction events, quarantined registry collision and explicit external-publication pending state

assumptions.runtime: repository checkout for deterministic validation only
assumptions.storage: generated transactions are stored outside canonical source in an approved immutable evidence plane
assumptions.authentication: NOT_APPLICABLE: the source validator and selector perform no provider authentication
assumptions.deployment: NOT_APPLICABLE_THIS_MISSION: publication is limited to a reversible branch and draft PR

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: JSON read models are sufficient
components.backend: estate_delta_transaction validator, chain verifier and exact-intent selector
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: this source layer validates externally persisted append-only events
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: no queued or background execution
components.worker: NOT_APPLICABLE: caller invokes deterministic library functions
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: hashes derive from current canonical JSON bytes
components.storage: JSON Schema, source catalog and public-safe pending pointer
components.authentication: NOT_APPLICABLE: no credential, token exchange or provider action

observability.correlation_ids: mission_id, transaction_id, sequence, event_hash, proof_action_id and route_definition_hash
observability.health_checks: schema parsing, chain verification, pointer validation and two exact route canaries
observability.structured_logs: caller-owned canonical validation results with no private identifiers
observability.audit_logs: external immutable transaction plus source and route catalog hashes
observability.metrics_alerts: named boundaries, open contradictions, chain failures, route ambiguity and runtime-binding gap

testing.unit: transaction integrity, projections, privacy, completion guard, route validation and exact selection
testing.integration: public pointer, schema, route catalog and existing Federation truth-boundary regressions
testing.e2e_or_smoke: build a bounded genesis transaction, reopen and verify it, then select both A0 source routes
testing.fixtures_mocks: in-memory public-safe census transaction and checked-in source-only route catalog
testing.failure_first: tamper, private locator, secret-shaped value, short known-private identifier collision, source-byte substitution or role swap, totality promotion, missing hold, wrong boundary count, ambiguous intent, unknown intent, effectful escalation and runtime activation claim

delivery.file_tree: one validator module, one event schema, one A0 route catalog, one public-safe pointer, one build contract and focused tests
test_commands: python -m unittest -v tests.test_federation_capability_twin tests.test_ao_cra_federation_inheritance tests.test_awareness_hash_domain_contract tests.test_awareness_hash_domain_reconciler tests.test_phoenix_provider_cutover_v3_surface_awareness tests.test_federation_resource_discovery
deploy_commands: No deployment is authorized; retain the source candidate in a draft PR
rollback_commands: Close the draft PR and abandon its purpose branch; no runtime or evidence state changes
delivery.debugging: Inspect validation error class, exact field path, event hash, route catalog hash and activation state; never inspect private values

watchman.policy: hold unproven routes, unresolved totality, private material, cost, burden and any runtime or provider authority claim
release_gates: Superior Logic and ECASP bounded-claim gate
exact-head branch and draft PR readback

continuity.idempotency: canonical JSON hashes make identical transaction and route definitions deterministic
continuity.checkpoints: source hash set, event chain head, route catalog hash, branch head and draft PR exact-head readback
continuity.resume_conditions: resume when the external evidence plane is authorized or the private selector can be independently rebound and read back
continuity.stop_switch: close the draft PR and do not bind the catalog into a runtime selector

proof.test_results: NOT_STORED_IN_CANONICAL_SOURCE: execute delivery.test_commands on the exact pull-request head and retain results in the approved evidence plane
proof.semantic_verification: REQUIRED_ON_EXACT_HEAD: verify the generic contract, census-genesis source-bundle projection, supporting-payload hashes, public aliases, collision build, privacy boundary and exact A0 routes without inferring publication, runtime activation or provider execution
known_scope_limits: GENESIS_ONLY_SOURCE_BUNDLE_SEMANTICS: later append-only event types receive structural and hash-chain validation only
AO-CRA-FEDREG-COLLISION-001: both private continuity projections remain quarantined and unselected pending governed readback
ROUTE_RUNTIME_BINDING_PENDING: the exact A0 source routes and current-main discovery adapter are not bound to a provider runtime
known_activation_obligations: publish and independently read back a generated census transaction in an approved external immutable evidence plane
resolve or explicitly supersede the quarantined continuity registry collision
bind both route intents into the private runtime selector and prove semantic readback
reconcile rather than silently compete with unmerged PR 618 if it is later admitted
